en.empty.efforts: This model provides no reasoning effort.
en.error.sessionInUse: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.
en.settings.desc: Judges peak/off-peak per provider + model and shows the rate and countdown in the model selector and the composer tool row.
en.settings.formUnavailable: The Host serves no peakrate configuration namespace, so this page cannot be edited.
en.settings.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or clear the field to restore the default.
en.settings.noSession: No session yet — open one and come back to read the model directory.
en.settings.refreshHoursHint: 0 disables auto-refresh; a save applies immediately, with no restart.
en.settings.saveFailed: The save was not accepted — try again.
en.settings.sourceFailed: Catalog fetch failed ({message}) — fell back to the bundled snapshot.
en.settings.suspiciousHint: No model under this provider matched a profile. It may genuinely have no time-based pricing, or its endpoint is unrecognized — if the latter, add a providerAliases entry in the config.
